task.goal: Cover the UNDOCKED week and its show history.
task.assignment: UNDOCKED week: pilots who flew this cycle (Marguerite Kimball-Ostrow, Manju Abebe, Soo Loo). Standings: Luis Taz leads the board — rank #1, 45.19 achievement points, 0 credits, 3 cycle(s) led, current streak 3. In the chair: Marguerite Kimball-Ostrow — Elementary Teacher; Manju Abebe — Plumber; Soo Loo — Corporate Accountant.
task.reportingQuestion: What did earlier approved UNDOCKED episodes record for the pilots in this week's assignment?

plan.focus: UNDOCKED pilots' performance in the latest cycle

sources.name: Marguerite Kimball-Ostrow
sources.quote: I didn't really have a strategy on Sunday or Wednesday nights. I just flew through the systems one by one, and it happened to come out even on credits. I wasn't really focusing on that; I was just trying to explore and see where the show would take me.

sources.name: Manju Abebe
sources.quote: My Monday and Thursday night routes on UNDOCKED were pretty different. On Monday, I went through Sol, Alpha Centauri, and a bunch of other stars, earning 9 points for Wanderer and a few other badges. Thursday night, I took a different path, starting with Sirius and Nova Terra, and earned Cartographer again, but with fewer points. Both nights, I came out even on credits and flew until the show's time ran out.

sources.name: Soo Loo
sources.quote: I think what changed between Tuesday and Friday nights was my strategy and the contracts I took. On Tuesday, I focused on the First Hunt: Belt-Grazers contract and sold some iron ore, but I got into a few fights. By Friday, I'd finished the First Hunt contract for a big payout and took on more contracts that rewarded exploration and trading, like Copper Requisition and Market Participation: Selling. I also sold more resources, which helped my credits. It was a more varied and successful approach, I guess.
